notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.81

• DuckWallet shows your card as it really looks: the camera keeps the card's own picture (Klarna's, PayPal's, your bank's design), with the number, name and dates painted out, and "•••• 1234" over it, as Apple's Wallet does. DuckPay shows the same picture. You can still pick colours instead.
• Cards that print their number in four stacked lines (1234 / 5678 / 9012 / 3456) are read too.
• DuckWallet checks the card: a number that isn't a real card number, or a date that has passed, is caught before it's added. It says whose card it is (from the name on the card, or the number's first six digits): for example "PayPal · Visa" or "Jyske Bank · Visa Debit · Denmark". A typed-in card from a known issuer gets its issuer's colours.
• Typing a card number or expiry date no longer jumps the cursor.
